title: Arms Sales Notification
items_summary: Correction to the graphic published for Transmittal No. 20-27 in notice document 2020-18478 (originally in the August 24, 2020 issue)
summary: This Federal Register notice corrects an earlier arms sales notice (document 2020-18478, published August 24, 2020) for Transmittal No. 20-27, because the wrong graphic was printed in error. The corrected graphic is embedded as an image, which the text does not describe, so the country, items, values, and contractors cannot be determined from this notice.
